classes.name: dude (Soldier)

classes.name: weapon
classes.desc: Weapon definition table initialized by weaponCreator(). Attributes: tag (id string), action ('semi'|'bolt'|'auto'|'burst'), ammo, maxAmmo, range, damage, recoil, bulk, rof, sound, jam (percentage chance), and magSprite.

classes.name: player.trenchSkill
classes.desc: Reinforcement call-in card deck in Trench mode. Card fields: type ('infantry'|'vehicle'|'teams'|'things'|'calls'), tier (1-5), cost (tactical points), subType, amount, timer, weapon, and weaponName.

classes.name: player.bc (Battle Conditions)
classes.desc: Active Battle Conditions modifying combat physics. Key flags include player.bcModRain, player.bcModDarkClouds, player.bcModAlliesSpeed, player.bcModAxisDetect, player.bcModAlliesJam, and player.bcModArty.

functions.name: setters.taps
functions.desc: Number of effective samples to take per pass. e.g. 3-tap is the current pixel and the neighbors each side. More taps = larger blur, but slower.

functions.name: setters.offset
functions.desc: Offset of each tap. For highest quality this should be <=1 but if the image has low entropy we can approximate the blur with a number > 1 and less taps, for better performance.

functions.name: setters.offset_type
functions.desc: Offset type, either 'weighted' or 'center'. 'weighted' gives a more accurate gaussian decay but can introduce modulation for high frequency details.

functions.name: setters.sigma
functions.desc: Sigma value for gaussian distribution. You don't normally need to set this.
